sloka: प्रजासुखत्वे चन्द्रस्य वसुधायाः क्ष्हमागुणैः ।बुध्या बृहस्पतेस्तुल्यो वीर्ये साक्षाच्छचीपतेः ॥२-२-३०॥
transliteration: prajāsukhatve candrasya vasudhāyāḥ kṣhamāguṇaiḥ ।budhyā bṛhaspatestulyo vīrye sākṣācchacīpateḥ ॥2-2-30॥

translations.english: He is equal to the Moon in causing happiness to the people, to the earth in forbearance, to Brihaspati in wisdom and to Indra in prowess.
